steps.name: Magic Soul (1)
steps.objective: After talking to [Saraswati] in the “compartment”, go to [Marie] in “Atlantis”.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Adventurer, you came as promised.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: At that time, I had no idea that Saraswati would suddenly appear.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Because the situation was so urgent, there was nothing we could do.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There's something I'd like to ask. Saraswati knew Bergelmir, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It was said that a weapon like Bergelmir destroyed the world.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Yes, it's true.
(The holographic keyboard in front of Saraswati disappears and a new holographic screen appears.)

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: It's a story from a long time ago. Adventurer You also know to some extent the past that is not here, but beyond the great wall... .

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Humanity has always fought for its own interests. The weak disappeared, and the strong survived and became history.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: There was always war in that history, and war had the power to defeat those who were defined as enemies.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it like a weapon?

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Yes, weapons have become increasingly sophisticated, going from being able to knock down an opponent to destroying a single star.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That’s something like Bergelmir… .

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Yes, Bergelmir is a weapon made by our ancestors... .

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Those who created the weapons defined the residences of those whose interests were not aligned with them as 'evil' and ordered them to be destroyed.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Some stars disappeared without a trace. Bergelmir's arrival was no coincidence.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: However, Bergelmir realizes that this star is not the one he should destroy and stays here.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: I'm analyzing why he did that, but I don't have an answer. What is certain, however, is that the machine-turned-man gained a soul... .

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Adventurer has already seen a similar form of something called a magic golem, or MG.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: I heard that there are often many mysterious things on this planet. Does anyone know anything about golems with souls?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A golem with a soul… Most golems are created by the user’s will…)

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: I would like you to ask questions without mentioning what happened in Oneiro Forest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay.  Then I'll look for it.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: I'll wait.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (First of all, I can't think of anyone... Should I ask Marie in Atlantis? She had Eraser...)

lines.speaker: 마리
lines.text: Hello, %s. It’s been a while since you were in Atlantis?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, how are you?

lines.speaker: 마리
lines.text: I see you came to see me. What's going on?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that's it... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Ask Marie about the magic golem with a soul.)

lines.speaker: 마리
lines.text: Eh… .

lines.speaker: 마리
lines.text: An MG with a soul? I don't know if it's artificial intelligence.

lines.speaker: 마리
lines.text: Although there are artificial intelligences that can converse with people, there is no such thing that has complete will of its own.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: 마리
lines.text: Is it magical? Do the people of Freios Continent know better?

lines.speaker: 마리
lines.text: I heard that the dwarf race has incredible technology. How about asking them?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will. Marie, thank you.

lines.speaker: 마리
lines.text: What? Good luck.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Then should I ask Dorun in Aki City...?)

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: Oh, hero! It's an honor for you to visit Dorun!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A brave man... . I'm not like that... .

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: That Dorun! It will help you, so just tell me!

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: Speak up!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. Why did I come here? .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Ask Dorun about the magic golem with a soul.)

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: Ahahaha… .

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: That Dorun! It will be helpful to you, so just tell us everything except about the magic golem!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahahahaha, I see.

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: Ah! I heard that there is a very good magic golem expert in the guild union city!

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: She's a little girl, and she has animal ears... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, is that the kid I passed by when I went to see Dana…? .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Dorun, thank you! Then let’s go!

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: Brave man! Please visit us again! I, Dorun, will be of help to you!

steps.name: Magic Soul (4)
steps.objective: Defeat [Bergelmir] in “Dreaming Oneiro” and obtain <Bergelmir’s Heart Fragment>.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Hello… do. Are you the one who came here recently? It's %s... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, that's right. The name is… It was Narsha, right? I've heard it from ambrosia and anise before.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Really? What are they trying to do again? .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, it's not like that. I came because I wanted to ask Narsha something.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Let me listen to it first.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you know that it is the soul of a magic golem?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Do you know about the soul? I think you came to know... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm not sure what you mean. Actually, the reason I asked Narsha about the magic golem was... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I briefly tell Narsha that I met and fought something like a giant golem in Oneiro Forest.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: You've done a lot since you came. I knew you were busy, but... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did you know me?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Since he's famous, there's no way he wouldn't know. I heard from President Dana that you have saved the world several times.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, then what… .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Among magic golems, there are some that can sometimes move without power. It's like he has an ego... .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: It is said that in ancient times, these magic golems often destroyed villages. So I needed control.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Freios is a place where magic is more active than other continents, so there are people who have the power to control magic golems. Me too... .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Anyway, that's why I started working on jobs that used magic golems and did research on them.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I mainly do a lot of research at the Sylvaria Empire Magic Agency. So, the terminology is also organized there, and the spirit of a magic golem that seems to have an ego that needs to be controlled is called a ‘magic soul.’

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Although it is different from that of ordinary life such as humans and animals. It's still not accurate, but... . It is also possible to transfer the magic soul... .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: It is definitely different from artificial intelligence that was created artificially.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Is this the answer, Adventurer?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, to some extent. Well then I'll just... .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Now, wait a minute… .
(Narsha grabs %s’s collar.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Adventurer, I have a favor to ask.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: There's something I'd like to find out more about, and if you don't mind, could you please postpone your departure for a while?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So what should I do?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I don't know if it's still there, but maybe Adventurer can find it again.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Could you find that golem, its parts, and bring them to me? Or something similar... . Then I'll find out more!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Oh, their eyes are so sparkly... I guess they're friends, they're the same as ambrosia and anise.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There is something I want to know too, so I will come. Wait.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I guess I should go to Oneiro first. Are there still traces of Bergelmir? .

steps.name: Magic Soul (5)
steps.objective: Defeat [Chloris] at the “Magic Academy Main Building” and obtain <Magic Book: Understanding Time and Space>. Then go to [Saraswati] in “Compartment 3”.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I've been waiting, Adventurer.
(Narsha's gaze is focused on the object in %s's hand.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, this… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm here, Narsha. It was a little difficult to get it.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Thank you, Adventurer. These are the parts of the golem.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Well then, let’s take a look… .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Could you please wait a moment?
(Narsha goes into what appears to be a warehouse and comes out holding something.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: The parts of the golem you brought are definitely different from the magic golems I've seen so far. In terms of technology, I think it's far superior to what's out there now.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Look at this… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It looks like an old part, right?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes, that's right. Old parts… . It's like a relic. It was discovered in the mountains of El Anor, and is a relic from the twilight years when the gods fought.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: At that time, some great being created a golem and made it move, but it fell from there.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Can you see it? This relic and the pattern engraved on this part... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think so. for a moment? If it's the same, it doesn't make sense... .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I don't know why that golem was in Moros, Eastland... . One thing is certain... .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: The golem said to be used by the gods and the golem seen in Oneiro Forest seem to be the same thing.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: And there are traces of metastasis?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Metastasis?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Would you like to see my Madori?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Madori?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Madori is the magic golem on my shoulder. The ‘magic soul’ was transferred from a huge body to a small body.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is there a way to make a large magic golem smaller? I've never heard of it... .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: There was help from the Magic Agency. Although it is currently in progress, you can think of it as transferring the magic soul, which is the ego that resides in the magic golem.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: It's a current technology, and it's still being researched... . I think this golem has already gone through that process.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I'm sorry for not being able to tell you clearly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay. This is enough.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Oh, I've seen a book written by the principal of magic school Zerenis! I saw something that mentioned space and time using the parts of the magic golem as an example.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I know there are quite a few copies of that book, and if you talk about it well, I think you might be able to get a copy.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: That might also be helpful to the person who sent Adventurer here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. I'll try to get that book.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I have more to say to you later, so please look for me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Later? all right. Then, let’s go to Zelenis Hill… .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Goodbye, Adventurer.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I feel like something strange is happening... . What on earth… ? I'll have to ask the president later.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: You are Adventurer. I didn't know you were here because you were thinking about something else. What you are holding in your hand is... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: At Saraswati's request, I went to see someone who knew a lot about golems.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He said it would be more helpful if he brought this book to Saraswati.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Thank you. I am tied to this place... . If you get a chance later, please tell him thank you.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: So, can you tell me what you heard?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yeah, that means… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I tell Saraswati the story I shared with Narsha. Questions about space and time and the magic soul….)

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Please wait a moment.
(The book given to Saraswati floats onto a huge screen and disappears into it like melting snow.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Saraswati… .

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: A soul that transfers... .

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Technology that was applicable to weapons thousands of years ago, but is only just beginning... .

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: And what national organization is doing it... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Different time zones… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (That might be….)

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: The cracks in the great wall really caused a lot of errors. It was really fortunate that I was able to stop and enter the space and time of Oneiro Forest at that time... .

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: There are a lot of doubts, but I'll leave it here for now. I will slowly find out the rest and let you know.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I also satisfied some of my curiosity.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: It looks like Adventurer will have a lot of work to do in the future.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Oh, if you get a chance later, I hope you can go see Minpye unnie. I'm really sorry about this... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay. Because I always have a lot of work to do.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll go. Saraswati. I feel like there's still more work to be done... .

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Yes… .
(After Saraswati confirms that all traces of %s have disappeared from D-Labo, a new screen is brought up.)

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: I think it's time to prepare some unused protocols... .
